text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT - CRITICAL - inference-queue-growth - autoscaler path failing. Pager: pagerduty-team-inference. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-1234

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident created: INC-1234. Trigger: queue_length > 500 for 5m. Primary: alice (oncall). Escalation policy: inference-oncall.

alice (oncall): acked. I'm on it, pulling metrics now.

carla (platform): I see the queue spike on grafana: https://grafana.company/d/inference/queue-length?panelId=3. queue_length peaked ~780 at 05:12 UTC. Autoscaler didn't add replicas — HPA target utilization shows 4/8 metrics missing from metrics-bridge.

dave (sre): p99 latency went from 120ms -> 2.1s, error-rate (5m) up to 3.2% (502/timeout-ish). GPU nodes show low util (20%) which suggests requests are piling in front of runtime, not processed. Possible broken metrics ingestion to autoscaler.

alice (oncall): quick customer impact: 20 tenants saw intermittent failed responses on long prompts (~>512 tokens). Mobile clients saw timeouts at 1.5–2s. No full region outage. Logging grouped: <https://logs.company/prod?q=service:inference+status:502>.

ben (oncall-next): I'm around, will take if you want to handoff. ETA 08:00 PT for shift change.

alice (oncall): handoff in ~35m. I'll attempt fast mitigation (manual scale + route fallback) then hand to ben.

carla (platform): Playbook snippet: runbook/autoscaler/manual-surge. Steps: 1) try `kubectl scale deploy inference-runtime -n prod --replicas=12` 2) if nodes insufficient, trigger nodepool resize: `gcloud container clusters resize ... --node-pool=highmem-accelerator --num-nodes=10` 3) watch queue drain. Also check metrics bridge logs: `kubectl logs -n infra metrics-bridge-...`

ops-runbook-bot: Confirmed playbook exists. Auto-checklist created: manual_surge_required=true.

dave (sre): Before resizing cloud nodes, try scaling replicas to soak existing nodes — they have CPU headroom (GPUs underutilized). Also reduce max_concurrency on the router for long prompts: `curl -X POST https://router.api/config -d '{"max_concurrency":6}'` (will throttle new long requests).

alice (oncall): executing manual scale now. Running: ```bash
kubectl scale deploy inference-runtime -n prod --replicas=12
```

alice (oncall): `deployment.apps/inference-runtime scaled` -> checking pods...

alice (oncall): new pods scheduling but `Pending` for 2 of them due to node capacity. I'll trigger nodepool increase as a fallback.

carla (platform): triggering nodepool resize now. Starting node pool increase to +3 nodes (highmem-accelerator). Note: will take ~4-6m to spin up.

alice (oncall): reduced router concurrency to 6. Pushing config now.

ben (oncall-next): good call on concurrency. Can we also add temporary route to dedicated-inference pool for heavy customers? I can flip a route flag if needed.

dave (sre): checking metrics-bridge logs while nodes spin up: ```
[ERROR] 05:10:12 metrics-bridge Error: timeout writing to metrics-queue (redis backlog ~120k)
[WARN ] 05:11:04 metrics-bridge Reconnect attempt 3
``` Looks like metrics ingestion delayed due to Redis backlog — autoscaler lacked current metrics for decisioning. Need follow-up on metrics pipeline.

carla (platform): ack. I'll open infra ticket for metrics pipeline. For now, manual surge + router throttle should stabilize.

alice (oncall): nodepool increase completed. New nodes registering. Pod `inference-runtime-abc` changed from Pending -> Running. Observing queue length dropping 780 -> 320 in ~3m.

alice (oncall): logs show worker throughput improving, tail snippet: ```
[05:18:32] INFO processed 120 req/s
[05:19:00] INFO queue_length=312
[05:20:12] INFO queue_length=210
```

ben (oncall-next): nice, keep an eye for 10m stable. Any persistent 502s?

dave (sre): error-rate trending down to 0.6%. P99 latency back to ~180ms. GPU utilization climbing to 55% as we drain. Looks good so far.

alice (oncall): notifying customer-facing: "We're seeing intermittent degraded performance for some long-running requests earlier, mitigation applied (manual scale + router throttle). Service stabilized, monitoring for 30m before full close."

carla (platform): created ticket INFRA-789 with logs from metrics-bridge + redis. Tagging SRE and infra.

ops-runbook-bot: Checklist update: manual_surge=true -> completed, nodepool_resize=completed, router_throttle=completed. Monitoring period started.

ben (oncall-next): I'll take the handoff in 25m. Alice, please DM me any notes for runbook updates if metrics pipeline needs retry/backpressure controls.

alice (oncall): will do. Quick root-cause hypothesis for RCA: metrics ingestion lag (redis backlog) prevented autoscaler from seeing queue increase; autoscaler did not scale and queue built up in front of runtime. Follow-ups: 1) increase metrics-bridge resilience/parallelism 2) add fallback for autoscaler to scale on queue_length from router (not just metrics-bridge) 3) add early-warning alert for redis backlog.

carla (platform): adding suggested action items to INFRA-789.

alice (oncall): marking incident as "stabilized". Will keep monitoring. If everything holds for 30m, we'll resolve PD incident and close thread.

pagerduty-bot: INC-1234 status changed: Acknowledged -> Resolved (resolution: manual surge + nodepool resize + router throttle), incident duration 00:18:26.

alice (oncall): closing thread. Thanks everyone. Follow-up: assign RCA to dave + carla.

ben (oncall-next): noted, will pick up RCA during handoff. Good job team. :thumbsup:
